in_arabic.name: مشرق
in_arabic.meaning: الشمال الشرقي هو المكان حيث يشرق الشمس
in_arabic.long_meaning: المشاريق اسم علم يعود لجذر "ش ر ق" بمعنى الشمال الشرقي، حيث يشرق الشمس في هذا المكان. يظهر هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة الآية 259، حيث يقول الله تعالى "وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَها مَنَازِلَ لِتُبَلَّغَ أَجَلُهَا أَجَلَ النَصْرِ وَكُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِيهَا كَانَ فِعلًا". ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الإسلام لوصف المكان الذي يشرق فيه الشمس، ويعتبر رمزًا للعلم والفضيلة.

in_urdu.name: مشریق
in_urdu.meaning: شمال مغرب کے پھلے حصے کی طرف ہوائیں کا جانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مشریق کا تعلق جذر "ش ر ق" سے ہے جو کہ شمالی مغربی پھلے حصے کے پھلے حصے کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس سے تعلق رکھنے والے لوگوں کے لیے مشریق ایک شاندار لقب ہے۔ اس کا استعمال اسلامی تعلیم اور مافوق الاطلاق کی علامت کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मशरीक
in_hindi.meaning: उत्तर पश्चिम की ओर हवाएँ चलना
in_hindi.long_meaning: मशरीक का अर्थ है उत्तर पश्चिम की ओर हवाएँ चलना और यह जड़ "श र ق" से मिलता-जुलता है। यह नाम हिंदू-मुस्लिम परंपरा में एक पवित्र नाम माना जाता है। इसका उपयोग मुस्लिम पिताओं द्वारा अपने बच्चों के लिए किया जाता है, जो कि एक शुभ और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: مشريق
in_pashto.long_meaning: مشريق د مشريقي جاز په پښتو کې د شمالي مغربی پښتون ځای ته ویل کیږي. د مشريق د لوی جادو د ځای ته هم اشاره کوي. د مشريق ویلای شو چې د شمالي مغربي پښتون ځای ته اشاره کوي کومګه شمالي مغرب ته وړي چې په لویه جادو کې د پښتونو لپاره یو ښه ځای دی.

in_english.name: Mashariq
in_english.meaning: Eastern winds or direction, symbolizing knowledge and virtue
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mashariq is derived from the Arabic roots 'sh-r-q', meaning 'east' or 'eastern direction'. In Islamic tradition, the name Mashariq is associated with knowledge, virtue, and spiritual growth. The Quranic reference to the name Mashariq in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:259) highlights the importance of the eastern direction as a symbol of guidance and wisdom. In Islamic culture, the name Mashariq is often bestowed upon individuals who embody these qualities, reflecting the cultural significance and spiritual importance of the name.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name "Mashariq" holds a significant meaning as it refers to the direction of the rising sun, often used in daily prayers as well as during the ritual of determining the new lunar month. Moreover, the eastern region is considered the birthplace of many Islamic civilizations, such as the Umayyad and Abbasid caliphates in present-day Iraq, contributing to a rich history and legacy in Islamic art, literature, and science.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, "Mashariq" symbolizes the concept of renewal and rebirth, as the sun rises every day to bring light and life to a new day. It is also associated with the idea of hope and optimism, as the rising sun represents a new beginning. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the first marks of creation appeared in the eastern direction, signifying the importance and significance of this direction in religious beliefs.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Mashariq' was used to refer to the eastern part of the Islamic Caliphate during the Umayyad Caliphate (661-750 CE).
historical_references.context: Geographical division of the Islamic Caliphate

historical_references.reference: During the Abbasid Caliphate (750-1258 CE), 'Mashariq' referred to the eastern territories under Abbasid control, including present-day Iraq, Iran, and parts of Central Asia.
historical_references.context: Administrative division of the Abbasid Empire

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic term 'Mashariq' refers to the four cardinal directions in Islamic geography: North, South, East, and West. In today's digital world, this term has gained significance through various technological platforms that offer location-based services. Google Maps, Waze, and Foursquare are prime examples of how Mashariq is being used in modern contexts. These platforms enable users to find directions, discover new places, and connect with communities based on their geographical location. The trend towards technology innovation and geolocation services has made Mashariq an essential concept in our daily lives, shaping the way we navigate and explore the physical and digital worlds.
